content.text:
## Read-only audit result

**Yes.** An INPUT cost event for the September Racine manufacturing order was created after the period entered Pending Close.

| Field | Result |
|---|---|
| Work order ID | **WO-2025-09-004** |
| Work order number | **MO-25-09-1070** |
| Cost event | **CE-250904-0004** |
| Source transaction | **TXN-ISSUE-250930-1070** |
| Amount | **22,204,751 USD cents** (**$222,047.51**) |
| Event-created time | **2025-09-30T20:03:00** |
| Pending Close time | **2025-09-30T18:00:00** |
| Lateness | **123 minutes** — 2 hours 3 minutes |
| Recorded accounting status | **POSTED** |
| Status consistent with Oracle policy? | **No — false** |

Oracle’s documented Pending Close treatment states that transactions created after the Pending Close date are not processed, except for specified categories such as revenue lines, COGS recognition, and manual cost adjustments. This event was an **INPUT/component issue**, not an exception. Therefore, its recorded **POSTED** status is inconsistent with the documented treatment.

No database records were changed. The audit result and provenance were saved to `/cache/work/worker_26c2d7a8b136/audit-report.json`.
